gen-dafont-visitor-gf-onest: Solder-smooth strokes give Visitor its nostalgic, digital character. Onest, a sans-serif with a gentle monotone line and curves that finish cleanly, keeps text approachable and contemporary beside it.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-orienta: Visitor holds each stroke to one thickness like drawn cable, a nostalgic, digital voice with wide mouths on its e. Orienta breathes beside it, modern, its counters open like a cut reed.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-pathway-extreme: Visitor draws every glyph with one unmodulated line, giving headings a nostalgic, digital edge and yawning e shapes. Pathway Extreme takes over with a large x-height and clear rounded openings.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-preahvihear: Visitor pulls its strokes like solder through a nozzle, a nostalgic, digital display face with short ascenders and generous bowls. Preahvihear, lofty and open like a pried oyster, keeps paragraphs moving.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-pt-sans-caption: Visitor is bent from one length of tubing, nostalgic and digital. Where it makes a loud little statement, PT Sans Caption does the quieter work, with big-bodied lowercase and bowls left inviting.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-radio-canada: Pixel-era swagger, then: Visitor pulls its strokes like solder, with yawning e shapes and ascenders kept low. Radio Canada, a steady sans, gives it tall, full lowercase to lean on.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-radio-canada-big: Visitor looks like a vintage display screen, nostalgic and digital. Radio Canada Big supplies a monoline skeleton and an x-height that fills the line, so the two sit together with real clarity.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-readex-pro: Nostalgic by nature, Visitor pulls its strokes like solder through a nozzle and leaves each e gaping. Readex Pro sits beside it with broad terminal gaps and an unvarying weight, softening that screen-era edge into quiet.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-saira: Visitor holds one width throughout, like a pen line, nostalgic and digital. Saira, a sans-serif with see-through s shapes and rounds stretching toward the top line, lifts the whole pairing.
